model: robust sequential Monte Carlo local-linear-trend state model
measurement_equation: y_t is a prespecified inlier/outlier Gaussian mixture around latent height h_t
predictive_interval: weighted particle-mixture quantiles, including both inlier and outlier observation components
transition_equation: h_t = h_(t-1) + dt*v_(t-1) + process noise; v_t = v_(t-1) + process noise
